Page 102
Rene Hand - 53 - Stroke two weeks ago
Thanks - Eleanor Czizek - 40 - Gall-stone trouble for at least 25 yrs. - practically O.K.
Wm. Purvis. .
Wm. A. Schiffman - 67 - away from Sacraments for 53 - poorly instructed . (Ist) wife asks for prayers .... .
Earl Patrick - 50 - High Church-Episcopal - had operation three weeks ago on tongue cancer. Now expects operation on jaw - going to Deacon- ess Hospital To-day - Enrolls
Fr. Coughlin. .. . President Roosevelt ... . leaders .... pray for them ....
Jan. 11th Mary Welfle - elderly lady wants a room - 5926 Mt. Elliott: See Mrs. Mc Kesina at 7720 E.LaFayette
Theodore Chaubeau - 55 - drinking - neglecting his family - wasting ...
Twins - Mary & Robert Piseopink - 6 - little girl strept throat ... brother leakage of Heart
Page 103
Jan 6th Julia Burch - 67 - invalid for 16 yrs - stroke ....
6th Helen Chekaway - 27 - strep-throat infection affecting her heart - En- rolled To-night.
7 Preter-Natural - Morris Mickelson - 18 - Very mysterious - paralysis - since 8 - Father Jewish, Mother russian, Brother agnostic. Young man remarkably intelligent, seemingly, though unable to speak, sit, or stand. Enrolled To-night (50c) by lady present - Prs.
7 Leo Bloom - 10 - looking up in the air last Wednesday (Jan. 4) felt something like piercing left eye ... blind every since -T
Ralph Bejma - 25th - "hopelessly paralysed ... 14 months in Eloise
9 Adolph Ovorus - 27 - Spinal trouble five years: recently very severe - hardly able to walk.
Chas. LaDonceur - 47 - Marine Hosp. serious heart trouble & dropsy.
